messages:
maria: Morning — async standup for Aurelia Health renewal escalation. Quick round: what I did / blockers / today.

jess: Did: triaged support ticket #4532, pulled prod traces for the 3/12 session drops. Blocker: can't reproduce on staging; prod shows repeated 502 from inference-proxy.

rahul: Looking into the prod traces now. I see a routing fallback at 02:10 UTC that kicked requests to a smaller model variant — token budget spiked. Short term we can force a dedicated route for their tenant to avoid fallback. Need CS ok to change routing policy.

jess: Customer is asking for an assurance before renewal next week. If we can guarantee dedicated routing during the renewal window they said they'll move forward.

maria: CS also has a legal/data residency ask — they require EU-only processing. Blocker: can we support EU-only for their tenant within ~2 weeks?

tom: EU-only private option in 2 weeks is tight but possible: VPC + dedicated pool in eu-west-1. Need signed PO and infra quota increases. Once PO is in, estimate ~10 biz days to finish config and capacity carve-out.

rahul: For the immediate routing fix I can deploy a temporary routing rule. Example config:
```yaml
routing:
  rules:
    - match: tenant == "aurelia"
      route: dedicated-eu
```
I'll test in staging first, then promote to prod during a low-traffic window.

jess: Great. Also adoption blocker: their webhook payloads are ~2x expected size and causing token cost blowup on our end. Any quick mitigations?

tom: Recommend asking them to gzip payloads client-side; we can enable prefix caching for common prompts on our side. Maria, can CS send a small SDK patch to them to add compression and payload trimming?

maria: Will draft SDK snippet + guidance and ask for PO. Scheduling a call Thurs 09:00 CET to align on SLA + routing. Who can join? @rahul for routing, @jess for ops.

ops-bot: Reminder: renewal_aurelia deadline in 7 days. Support ticket #4532 updated with latest traces.

rahul: :thumbsup: I'll prepare a rollback and test plan, target to run staging test at 06:00 UTC tomorrow.

jess: I'll prepare the customer message + the SDK patch. Blocker for routing change cleared pending infra confirmation.

maria: Quick ask — PR 8923 (tenant-aware routing) needs one more approval before I can promote the change. @tom @rahul can you review today?

tom: On it, aiming to review by EOD.

maria: Thanks team — will update the customer after Tom confirms capacity and after Rahul runs the staging test.
